milestones.label: Facebook launches
milestones.detail: The dominant social network is founded (Feb 2004).

milestones.label: Facebook News Feed
milestones.detail: The algorithmic feed that organises what users see is introduced (5 Sep 2006).

milestones.label: Facebook 'Like' button
milestones.detail: A lightweight engagement signal that begins to drive ranking (Feb 2009).

milestones.label: Twitter algorithmic timeline
milestones.detail: Twitter switches from chronological to engagement-ranked (Feb 2016).

milestones.label: Facebook 'Meaningful Social Interactions'
milestones.detail: A reranking later reported to have boosted divisive, anger-laden content (WSJ 'Facebook Files', 2021).

milestones.label: George Floyd video goes viral
milestones.detail: A bystander video spreads globally within days, intensifying scrutiny of policing (25 May 2020).
